cases.note: left: 'right' with a width: the switch puts it at the right edge
left: 'center' with a width
top: 'bottom' with a height
right: 'right' alone: the default left goes, the word is right's
bottom: 'middle' with a height
left: 'left' is 0%, top: 'top' 0%
top 300 and bottom 300 on 400: the height is -200 and BoundingRect flips it
left 400 and right 400 on 600: the width flips
left, width and right all written: the merge keeps the three, the width wins
left: 'auto' with a right: the merge keeps the default left out, auto is NaN
no grid component: the default grid, its width and height the root's
a grid right written null reads the root right
a grid top written null reads the root's 'middle', its height the root's
a single axis with left 'center' and top 'bottom'
a single axis with the root height under it
a title whose left is null: the root's 'right'
a title with the root top 'bottom' (its own top a default, the merge nulls nothing)
a legend whose left is null: both edges read the root, right 10
a pie with no width: the root width 300 boxes it
a funnel with the root width and a top written null
a tree whose width the root gives
a treemap with the root height and top null
a sankey with the root width
a calendar with the root width and its top null
a parallel with the root width and height
the root's silent: true makes the bar series silent
the series' own silent: false wins over the root's true
a series silent written null reads the root's
the root's silent 1 is truthy (`!!`)
a markLine with the root's silent: true, on a series that says false
the markLine of sil-marker with no silent anywhere: not silent, it answers the pointer
a scatter has no progressive of its own: the root's 1000 and threshold 500
a scatter with nothing written: the global defaults 400 / 3000
a large scatter: 5e3 / 1e4 whatever the root says
a line's own 0 keeps the root's out
a line's progressive written null reads the root's
a large bar's own 3000; its threshold the root's
a candlestick's own threshold 1e4 and chunk mode 'mod'
a scatter's chunk mode is the root's
a root progressive written null: getShallow's end, null
a pie's left 'auto' with a width: not a number to getLayoutRect, so the pie hangs on its right
a pie's left 'abc' with a right: parseFloat's NaN, the box from the right
a funnel's left 'auto' with a width and the root's width under it: 'auto' is its own, no climb
a root stack: every bar stacks on the one before
a root stack: the second line's points stand on the first's
the root's barWidth and barGap: a 10 px bar, a bar's width apart
the root's barCategoryGap and barMaxWidth
a polar bar with the root's stack and barWidth
a candlestick with the root's barMaxWidth
the root's selectedMode reaches get() but not the selection: nothing is selected
a series' own selectedMode false: nothing either
a treemap has no z of its own: the root's
the graphic component has no z of its own: an element's z written null takes the root's
legendHoverLink: a type with no default reads the root's
a root symbol reaches a scatter (no default) but not a line; symbolRotate reaches both

guards.name: g-left-right: the switch puts x at W - width
g-flip-v: the flipped height is positive
g-flip-h: the flipped width is positive
g-root-default: the root's width reaches the default grid
g-root-null: the root's right replaces a null
s-root: the root's height reaches a single axis
b-title: the root's left reaches the title
b-pie: the root's width reaches the pie
sil-root: silent
sil-own-false: not silent
sil-own-null: silent
sil-marker: the marker silent through the root
sil-marker-loud: the marker answers
p-scatter: the root's progressive
p-line: the line's own 0
p-line-null: a null climbs
p-candle: the candlestick's own chunk mode
b-pie-auto: 'auto' is not the root's left: the pie hangs right (cx 500)
c-stack-bar: the second series stands on the first
c-bar-sizes: the root's barWidth 10
c-select: the root's selectedMode reaches get()
c-select: and selects nothing
c-select-own: nothing
c-treemap-z: the root's z
c-graphic-z: the null z takes the root's, the unwritten one 0
c-hoverlink: the heatmap reads the root's false
c-symbol: the scatter's symbol is the root's rect, the line's its own
